title: Green synthesis of new adamantane-containing dihydropyrimidine derivatives as potential anticancer agents
content:

Adeleh Moshtaghi Zonouz, Mina Abkar Aras, Nahideh Jafari, Zahra Rezaei, Hamed Hamishehkar
Adamantane-containing dihydropyrimidine derivatives were synthesized under solvent-free conditions and their cytotoxic activities were evaluated against the A-549 lung cancer cells.
